$comment: Advisories accepted by scripts/audit.mjs. Keyed by advisory URL so a NEW advisory for the same package still fails the gate. Every entry must carry a reason and an expiry date; an expired entry fails the build on purpose.

advisories.reason: Transitive dev dependency of vitest (test runner). The gadget needs attacker-controlled worker options in the test runner; this repo runs `vitest run` on its own committed tests, never the Vitest UI or browser mode, and never with untrusted config. Fixed only by vitest 4/5, which npm cannot currently resolve against this lockfile.
Same transitive dev-only worker pool (vitest). Same exposure argument as GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3.
